findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:1 evidence command returns 0 at re-run, not 1 as claimed. The grep pattern `execFileSync.*verify-koala-residue|timeout.*koala` does not match the actual code: `execFileSync` is called with variable `scriptAbs` (not the literal string verify-koala-residue), and `timeout:` appears on a separate line from `koala` (it references constant KOALA_RESIDUE_TIMEOUT_MS). The underlying behavior (execFileSync with timeout) is real and visible at lines 123-125 of review-preflight.ts, but the literal evidence command produces 0 matching lines, contradicting the noted result of 1. Per evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command rule, a result mismatch on a must-priority intent is a blocker.

CHK-001:adversarial:1 evidence command returns 1 at re-run, not 0 as claimed. The command `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts | grep -cE '^-.*ENGLISH_ARTIFACTS_GATE|^-.*channel|^-.*concept|^-.*lint|^-.*docs-drift|^-.*codex-adapter'` matches the removed union type line: `- name: 'channel' | 'concept' | 'lint' | 'docs-drift' | 'codex-adapter' | 'english-artifacts';` — this line was removed and replaced with the extended 7-member version adding koala-residue. The underlying 6 gates are intact in the new line; no gate logic was removed. But the evidence note claims the command returns 0 when it actually returns 1, contradicting the literal result. Per evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command rule, a result mismatch on a must-priority intent is a blocker.
